_comment: Golden fixtures for the lib/game-utils.ts <-> api/app/utils/game_utils.py parity test required by CR-105-FINDINGS.md Table 2 / Addendum 2. Both lib/__tests__/game-utils-parity.test.ts (TS, via jest fake timers) and api/tests/test_game_utils_parity.py (Python, via an injectable `now`) load this same file and assert identical booleans against the SAME `now` reference instant. If you change the pick-lock rules in either lib/game-utils.ts or api/app/utils/game_utils.py, add/update cases here so both suites re-verify the other language wasn't left behind.

gameStatusCases.name: not started - starts in the future
in progress - started 1h ago, within 2.5h buffer
completed by time - started 3h ago, past 2.5h buffer
completed by stored status trumps a future startTime
no time info at all - falls back to stored status
exactly at start time boundary (now == startTime)
exactly at the 2.5h completed boundary (now == startTime + 2.5h)
date field fallback when startTime is absent

gameweekStartedCases.name: pick week == game week, both positive -> started
pick week != game week -> not started
targetWeek provided but gameWeek is 0 -> not started
null/missing week fields treated as 0 -> not started

picksLockedCases.name: existing pick + gameweek not started -> unlocked
no existing pick + gameweek started -> unlocked (first pick allowed)
no existing pick + gameweek not started -> unlocked
